summary.zh: 用日志、指标和追踪看清线上运行
summary.en: Add structured logs, metrics and tracing to Python services.

description.zh: 覆盖结构化日志、指标采集和分布式追踪的落地写法，让线上服务查得到、测得出。新增日志、接入监控，或排查只在生产环境出现的问题时使用。
description.en: Practical patterns for structured logging, metrics collection and distributed tracing in Python services. Use it when adding logs, wiring up monitoring or debugging behaviour that only shows up in production.
